svg.title: ILO-defined unemployment and category A registration in France, 2024
svg.desc: Bar in three segments, in thousands of people, 2024 average (Insee estimate): 863 people unemployed under the ILO definition not registered in category A, 1,427 in both at once, 1,466 category A registrants who are not unemployed under the ILO definition. Unemployed (ILO): 2,290, of whom 62% registered in category A. Category A registrants: 2,893, of whom 49% unemployed under the ILO definition.
svg.text: ILO-defined unemployment and category A registration in France, 2024
two definitions, populations that partly overlap (thousands of people)
Unemployed (ILO definition): 2,290, of whom 62% registered in A
Registered in category A: 2,893, of whom 49% unemployed (ILO)
of whom: not registered 524; registered in B or C 240;
inactive outside the halo 503; in work 236
Insee Références, Emploi, chômage, revenus du travail, 2026 ed., file 1, figures 2 and 8 (Dares-Insee-France Travail
